comment: I respect Dr. Gomez so much! He shows that he cares about his students and acknowledges effort. Labs with him are great; he ensures that students feel comfortable with what they are doing. It is clear that he reads evaluations and listens to the needs of the students!

Dr. Gomez is a great professor who really cares about his students. He is always clear about what info will be on each exam and has an interesting sense of humor. Class was lecture w/ case studies & paper dissections. Sometimes he would be unclear in his grading of labs and would move through lectures too quickly but overall awesome professor!

This isn't your typical "easy" bio class - you're gonna need to study. He goes through lectures really quickly and can be a tough grader a times. However, he likes getting feedback from his students so that he can become a better professor. He chastised me a couple of times in class for talking, but would pull me aside each time and apologize.

H is a great teacher. Class is mostly lectures with some case studies. For our two midterms and final he clearly told us what would be on them. In lab we wrote introductions and results sections. He was not always the most clear on the grading criteria for those. Overall really nice caring teacher. If you pay attention and study you can get an A.

Dr. Gomez is the best professor I've had at Richmond so far. I have taken him for Bio 199 & Bio 200. He does a great job at making sure student's understand the material and is easily available outside of class. Also, he understands that not everyone is great at test taking, so there are many other grades that help balance out your grade. Take him!

Dr. Gomez is the best professor I had this semester! He is very knowledgeable, very funny, and cares about his students a lot. His grading system is awesome, because he takes into account that not everyone is good with tests, so he gives you a lot of chances to prove you understand the material. He made me consider a Biology minor. Take him!

I had Dr. Gomez for my genetics lab and he is awesome. He is super fair and really understanding. The only thing I could ask him to work on would be to take better notes on the board or to ask him to switch to using power point because I can't read what he writes.
